headline: Congress named a Renton, Washington post office building after musician Jimi Hendrix.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 4301 Northeast 4th Street in Renton, Washington, as the "James Marshall 'Jimi' Hendrix Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the new name applies from that date.
